briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier model arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs push multimodal frontier models. Funding remains robust while safety concerns grow around agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 sparking developer adoption.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $15B data center expansion; TSMC ramping 3nm AI chips for xAI and Google.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve coherent long-term planning before 2028?
